title: Certidão — civil registry certificate
description: The 32-digit matrícula of a certidão de registro civil (birth, marriage, death and the other acts of the registro civil das pessoas naturais).

format.summary: Formats the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into the printed mask of the norm, the 32 digits grouped as 6 2 2 4 1 5 3 7 2 and separated by spaces.
description: Formats the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into the printed mask of art. 473 of the Código Nacional de Normas: the 32 digits grouped as 6 2 2 4 1 5 3 7 2, separated by spaces.
- The mask is applied as far as the digits go; `options.pad` left-pads with zeros to 32 digits first.
- A full 32-digit matrícula does not fit an integer, so it has to be given as a string.

getInfo.summary: Parses the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into its fields.
description: Parses the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil into its fields; returns null when it is not valid (same rules as `certidao.isValid`).

- Fields: CNS of the serventia (6 digits), acervo, service (always `55`), year, book type (birth, marriage, religious marriage, death, stillbirth, banns, other, emancipation, interdiction) and its raw code 1 to 9, book, page, term and the 2 check digits.
- Art. 473 V lists only book codes 1 to 7; codes 8 (emancipação) and 9 (interdição) are also accepted.

isValid.summary: Validates the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil (nascimento, casamento, óbito and the other acts kept by a serventia de registro civil das pessoas naturais).
description: Validates the 32-digit matrícula of a certidão de registro civil (art. 473 of the Código Nacional de Normas da Corregedoria Nacional de Justiça).
- Layout: CNS da serventia (6), acervo (2), serviço (2, always `55`), ano (4), tipo do livro (1), livro (5), folha (3), termo (7) and 2 modulus 11 check digits.
- The serviço must be `55` and the book type one of the nine books (`0` is rejected).
- `options.accept` narrows the valid book types to the listed ones (default: every type).
- Accepts the value masked or not, with whitespace between and around the groups.

parse.summary: Removes the formatting of the matrícula of a certidão de registro civil and returns only digits.
description: Removes the formatting of a certidão matrícula and keeps only digits, capped to 32 digits.

tests.name: caps-length
tests.note: reference truncates to 32 digits; asserted by the reference (JS) unit tests
